Foreign Affairs Section,
C. & S. Branch.       xxxxxx
                                        January 26th, 1943.

        Further on Yellow Federation (The Racial
        Regrouping of Asiatics).

    During the course of further enquiries into
this case, C.D.S. 545 elicited the following informa-
tion:-

1. Name: The Yellow Federation (The Racial Regrouping
           of Asiatics).
2. Place: 197 Ferry Road.
3. President: Mr. Daung Ying (崔), said to be a
              Japanese subject.
4. Date of Formation: January 4th, 1943.
5. Object: The object of this organization, it is
           ascertained, is to regroup the Asiatic
           races as is indicated by its name, and
           the sphere of its function will not only
           be confined to Shanghai, but also extended
           throughout the Pacific Area.
6. Members' Fee: At present no members' fee is
                 collected.
7. Members: Since its inauguration on 4-1-43, the
            Yellow Federation has up to the present
            enlisted approximately 80 members.
8. Comment: Ostensibly this organization is in the
            nature of a club, but in reality it has
            political motives mainly for the aim of
            regrouping and promoting Asiatics.

(FILE)
            Annexed to the Headquarters at 197 Ferry
Road is the "China Economic Investigation Bureau
(中國經濟調查處)" which also comes under the charge
of the Japanese, Mr. Daung Ying. This latter office
is said to be conducting intelligence work.

            Latest information is to the effect that
the heads of the Yellow Federation are at present in
the course of submitting applications to the local
competent Authorities requesting permission to allow
them to operate.

            A copy of rules and regulations has been
obtained and is attached herewith.
Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,                D. S. I.
C. & S. Branch.

        关于黄盟（亚洲人种族重组）的后续报告。

    在对此案的进一步调查中，刑警第二科545号探员陶金言（Tao Chin Yen）获取了以下信息：-

1. 名称：黄盟（亚洲人种族重组）。
2. 地点：斐伦路197号。
3. 主席：Daung Ying（崔）先生，据称为日本籍臣民。
4. 成立日期：1943年1月4日。
5. 宗旨：经查，该组织的宗旨如其名称所示，旨在重组亚洲各族，其活动范围不仅限于上海，还将扩展至整个太平洋地区。
6. 会费：目前不收取会费。
7. 成员：自1943年1月4日成立以来，黄盟截至目前已招募约80名成员。
8. 评论：该组织表面上具有俱乐部性质，但实际上具有政治动机，主要目的是重组和促进亚洲人的团结。

（归档）
            附设于斐伦路197号总部的是“中国经济调查处”，该处也由日本人Daung Ying负责。据悉，该机构正在从事情报工作。

            最新情报显示，黄盟负责人目前正在向当地主管当局提交申请，请求批准其开展活动。

            已获取章程副本一份，随函附上。
外事科主管警官，                D. S. I.
刑事与特别处。

January 11th, 1943.

Report on the Yellow Federation. (The
Racial Regrouping of Asiatics).

FILE

C.D.C. 545, Tao Chin Yen, obtained
information and made enquiries into the activities
of the Yellow Federation. 黃錢

The Yellow Federation for the purpose
of racial regrouping of Asiatics formally inaugurated
on January 4th, 1943, at its Headquarters, No. 197
Ferry Road. It was presided by one Daung Ying
(唐瑛), said to be a Japanese subject. The
Chinese principal of this organization is one Zung
Nan Soong (南松), native of Taichow, proprietor
of the Pah Hsien (八仙), lodging house, Rue Marco
Polo (八仙橋), F. C. On the 6-1-43, another
meeting was held when it was attended by about
20 persons. They discussed and decided to commence
recruiting members.

All the expenses in connection with
the affairs of the Federation are at present being
borne by the Japanese who assumed the name of Daung
Ying.

Enquiries are being continued and further
activities of this Federation and its nature will be
reported upon later.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
C. & S. Branch.

关于黄盟（亚洲人种族重组）的报告。

归档

刑警第二科545号探员陶金言（Tao Chin Yen），获取了有关黄盟活动的情报并进行了调查。 黃錢

旨在重组亚洲人种族的黄盟于1943年1月4日在其总部斐伦路197号正式成立。会议由一名叫Daung Ying（唐瑛）的人主持，据称为日本籍臣民。该组织的中方负责人为Zung Nan Soong（南松），台州人，法租界马可波罗路（八仙桥）“八仙”旅馆老板。1943年1月6日，举行了另一次会议，约有20人出席。他们讨论并决定开始招募成员。

目前，与联盟事务相关的所有费用均由化名Daung Ying的日本人承担。

调查仍在继续，该联盟的进一步活动及其性质将在日后报告中呈报。

D. S. I.

外事科主管警官，
刑事与特别处。

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 1740 Date 15/1/42）
Foreign Affairs Section,
C. & S. Branch File No. Date January 11th, 1943.

SUBJECT: Report on the Yellow Federation. (The Racial Regrouping of Asiatics). (黄盟)

C.D.S. 545, Tao Chin Yen, obtained information and made enquiries into the activities of the Yellow Federation.

The Yellow Federation for the purpose of racial regrouping of Asiatics formally inaugurated on January 4th, 1943, at its Headquarters, No. 197 Ferry Road. It was presided by one Daung Ying (唐瑛), said to be a Japanese subject. The Chinese principal of this organization is one Zung Nan Soong (陳南松), native of Taichow, proprietor of the Pah Hsien (八仙), lodging house, Rue Marco Polo (八仙橋), F. C. On the 6-1-43, another meeting was held when it was attended by about 20 persons. They discussed and decided to commence recruiting members.

All the expenses in connection with the affairs of the Federation are at present being borne by the Japanese who assumed the name of Daung Ying.

Enquiries are being continued and further activities of this Federation and its nature will be reported upon later.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
C. & S. Branch.
